body:
## Problem

Every pi session currently fails at startup:

```
Error: Failed to load extension ".../.pi/agent/extensions/soma-path-guard.ts": Cannot find module 'bun:ffi'
Require stack: - .../soma/src/core/dir-lock.ts
```

pi loads its extensions under Node. Since node #939 (#1023), `src/core/index.ts` has re-exported `dir-lock.ts`, which imports `bun:ffi`. The path-guard extension imports that barrel (`policy-path-guard.ts → ../core/index`), so pi breaks for the principal, for ranger's pi lane, and for abacus-friday (G8).

## Fix

- `dir-lock.ts` is no longer re-exported from the barrel. It is declared as its own public entry of `core` in `src/components.ts`, and `goal-accept.ts` imports it directly.
- New `test/pi-dev-extension-imports.test.ts` walks the static import graph of every projected pi extension and fails on any `bun:` module. It was red before the fix (`dir-lock.ts -> bun:ffi`) and is green after.

## Verification

- With this tree projected into a fresh HOME, `pi --print --mode json` loads every extension and completes a tool-using run on spark/longctx-think.
- `bun run test` passes (4009 tests, 0 failing) on the stacked branch for #1007, which contains this tree. Typecheck and lint are clean.
